question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        ds.driver_id,
        SUM(ds.points) as total_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, ds.driver_id
),
constructor_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
driver_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rank
    FROM driver_points
),
constructor_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        constructor_id,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rank
    FROM constructor_points
)
SELECT 
    dr.year,
    d.full_name,
    cr.constructor_id,
    c.name as constructor_name,
    dr.total_points as driver_points,
    cr.total_points as constructor_points
FROM driver_ranked dr
INNER JOIN constructor_ranked cr ON dr.year = cr.year AND dr.rank = cr.rank AND dr.rank = 1
INNER JOIN drivers_ext d ON dr.driver_id = d.driver_id
INNER JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY dr.year DESC
